calls.reason: Ramp measures spending concentration, not customers' inability to pay. Anthropic's filing documents losses, but neither source establishes the claimed 80% distressed-customer revenue share.
Reported SpaceX borrowing and Oracle's financing plan show substantial debt financing, but do not establish that every named buyer must borrow tens of billions. Purchase programs remain ongoing.

Data Phoenix reports falling project-bond prices, and TechSpot describes AWS hardware storage. Neither establishes hundreds of billions in stored chips; the broader nightmare characterization is rhetoric.
TrendForce documents memory shortages, capacity constraints and rising prices. It neither establishes nor rules out Huang-directed early deliveries as a material cause.

Blackstone discloses a major AI investment, diversified businesses and limits on liability. These do not settle its dependence on AI, and staking its entire future is an undefined rhetorical characterization.

Reuters reports mixed investor reactions to 45% growth and roughly $414 billion in commitments extending seven to ten years. It does not establish the claimed market-wide causal explanation or exclusive dependence on growth.
